title: ConnectionsHelperConsentResult
description: Result of the connections.helperConsent JSON-RPC method: which fingerprint was answered and how, so the renderer's retry of the open is keyed on the identity the backend actually wrote rather than its own copy of the request. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the host key the answer was recorded under.

answer.description: The answer as written (internal/helper/consent.Answer): granted or denied.
